repeatability.note: Two runs of the same test in one local environment; descriptive only.

result: A single initial 100-card page is strongly page-order-sensitive in this synthetic corpus. The all-visible lexical scorer ranks the exact target first, but its timings exclude project visibility resolution, D1 fetches, serialization, and provider calls.
limitations: Synthetic sorted IDs and exact lexical labels; no D1, model, provider, user workload, or production latency is measured.
The first-page arm models one current blackboard.cards page; callers can request later pages using next_cursor.
All-visible recall is a lexical ranking ceiling, not an independent relevance or user-utility score.
Single local run; reported milliseconds are descriptive and hardware-dependent.
